mapper.sql: u.user_id AS "userId", u.login_id AS "loginId", u.display_name AS "displayName", u.use_yn AS "useYn", u.status, k.staff_no AS "staffNo", k.staff_name AS "staffName", k.organization_code AS "organizationCode", o.organization_name AS "organizationName", k.position_name AS "positionName", k.job_title AS "jobTitle", k.employment_status AS "employmentStatus", k.retirement_date AS "retirementDate", k.last_synced_at AS "lastSyncedAt", COALESCE(string_agg(DISTINCT ur.role_code, ','), '') AS "roleCodes"
mapper.select: SELECT FROM user_account u LEFT JOIN korus_staff_snapshot k ON k.staff_no=u.staff_no LEFT JOIN organization o ON o.organization_code=k.organization_code LEFT JOIN user_role ur ON ur.user_id=u.user_id AND ur.status='ACTIVE' AND ur.use_yn='Y' WHERE u.user_id=#{userId} GROUP BY u.user_id,u.login_id,u.display_name,u.use_yn,u.status,k.staff_no,k.staff_name,k.organization_code,o.organization_name,k.position_name,k.job_title,k.employment_status,k.retirement_date,k.last_synced_at
mapper.update: UPDATE user_account SET use_yn=#{useYn}, change_reason=#{reason}, updated_at=now() WHERE user_id=#{userId}
UPDATE user_role SET status='REVOKED', use_yn='N', updated_at=now() WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND assignment_type='MANUAL' AND status='ACTIVE'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_role (user_id, role_code, assignment_type, approved_by, effective_start_date, status, use_yn, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{roleCode}, 'MANUAL', #{approvedBy}, CURRENT_DATE, 'ACTIVE', 'Y', now(), now())
mapper.select: SELECT count(*) FROM role WHERE role_code=#{roleCode} AND deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT o.organization_code AS "organizationCode", o.organization_name AS "organizationName", o.organization_type AS "organizationType", o.source_system AS "sourceSystem", o.use_yn AS "useYn", o.status FROM organization o o.organization_code=#{f.organizationCode} ORDER BY o.organization_code

SELECT relation_id AS "relationId", organization_code AS "organizationCode", parent_organization_code AS "parentOrganizationCode", effective_start_date AS "effectiveStartDate", effective_end_date AS "effectiveEndDate", status, created_at AS "createdAt" FROM organization_relation WHERE organization_code=#{organizationCode} ORDER BY effective_start_date DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO organization_relation (organization_code, parent_organization_code, effective_start_date, effective_end_date, status, change_reason, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{organizationCode}, #{parentOrganizationCode}, #{startDate}::date, NULLIF(#{endDate}, '')::date, 'ACTIVE', #{reason}, now(), now())
